hooks.commandWindows: $ONMHJ_ROOT = if ($env:CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT) { $env:CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT } elseif ($env:CODEX_PLUGIN_ROOT) { $env:CODEX_PLUGIN_ROOT } elseif ($env:ONMHJ_ROOT) { $env:ONMHJ_ROOT } else { '' }; if (-not $ONMHJ_ROOT) { exit 0 }; node (Join-Path $ONMHJ_ROOT 'bin\onmhj.js') hook SessionStart

$ONMHJ_ROOT = if ($env:CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT) { $env:CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT } elseif ($env:CODEX_PLUGIN_ROOT) { $env:CODEX_PLUGIN_ROOT } elseif ($env:ONMHJ_ROOT) { $env:ONMHJ_ROOT } else { '' }; if (-not $ONMHJ_ROOT) { exit 0 }; node (Join-Path $ONMHJ_ROOT 'bin\onmhj.js') hook UserPromptSubmit
